title: Stacker
about: Skill-based stacking. Keep the overlap and aim for the top, with no checkpoints or payout.

title: Tetris
tagline: Make room for the next idea.
about: Seven-bag Tetris on a paper board with hold, ghost piece and short mechanical key clicks.

title: Tetris vs Jev
about: A live head-to-head Tetris race against the Jev model on a shared seven-bag.
note: Every race makes billed API calls.

title: Breakout
about: Clear Gate, Chevron, then Islands. No power-ups and no speed-ups; just the angle of the paddle.

title: Snake
about: Offline Snake with a seedable food sequence.

title: Invaders
about: Clear each wave before it lands. Enemy attacks are seedable for repeatable runs.

title: Pong
about: Solo Pong against the wall-and-paddle machine. Audio can be muted for the whole session.
controls: Up / Down or W S  paddle

title: Galaga
about: An offline formation shooter with original text graphics and repeatable enemy choices.

title: Crossing
about: Hop through traffic and ride the logs home. Lanes are fixed patterns, so every run is learnable.

title: Tron
tagline: Leave a line, cut a line.
about: Light cycles on a paper grid. Beat the machine (easy, normal or hard) best of five; a second player can join with --two-player.

title: Tron vs Jev
about: Light cycles against the Jev model: it chooses routes while your cycle keeps moving, and a slow reply can cost it the round. Best of five.
note: Every match makes billed API calls.

title: Wordle
about: Offline Wordle with duplicate-aware clues and a repeatable answer seed.
controls: F2  restart, F3  mute, Esc  quit

title: Pac-Man
tagline: Clear the page, dot by dot.
about: Offline Pac-Man on an original maze. Bookmark draws ghosts to a tile; Eraser opens a thin wall. Use --classic to disable both.
